confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are rough: sources were travel aggregators and older or cruise-ship menus, mixed currencies (USD, EUR, CUP, CUC), and no current 2026 Havana bar menus were found. Beer, coffee, cocktail and wine are bounded estimates tied to tourist-venue levels. Restaurant anchors come from a 6 USD cheap-meal figure and a 20 to 27 USD mid-range two-person figure, with a 2 to 8 USD range for basic meals. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Havana context, not checked against live listings. Havana's dual-economy pricing and shortages make prices volatile. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could verify (20 March 2026), not a November 2026 value; a search for the RBA F11 series did not return a current official observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city was used. The basis is tourist-oriented price levels in Caribbean and Latin American capitals, adjusted for Havana's shortages, dual-currency pricing and the prevalence of casas particulares for lodging.
